title: fix(plugin-detail): after a 409, the stage menu asks what the re-read record needs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XTRdLmK9YYgMSCJ7NH2PuUY)_

Fixes #36036

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 记录详情页抬头的阶段下拉菜单:保存遇到「别人刚改过这条记录」后,弹窗按重新读到的记录重算要填的字段,别人已填好的字段不再出现,也不会被覆盖;之前会被覆盖。
- 属于「记录页阶段推进」这一组改进的收尾,补上前一张卡(阶段弹窗改用共享补填对话框)评审时留下的一个缺口。
- 出错时最坏是弹窗仍要求填写已被别人填好的字段(即回到改动前的行为);只改一个界面文件,可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

- `useStageChange` (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordPathStageChange.tsx`): the header stage menu's dialog no longer shows the field list frozen at the pick. Each render it asks `collectRequiredWhenPromptFields` (the one shared evaluator, unchanged, same `fillable`) against the record as it stands. After a 409 the re-read row arrives through the record context, so the list follows it: a field another writer filled leaves the dialog, and the dialog sends only the fields it shows, so the move no longer carries it.
- A value the reader typed for a pick-time field that is no longer asked is also kept out of the chained-requirement check (`moreFields`). Otherwise a typed `loss_reason: other` would still ask for `loss_detail` after the other writer stored a different reason.
- When nothing is left, the dialog is the move's confirmation again: record name, the stage row, "Move this record to X?", Cancel and Move, plus the 409 note at its foot.
- Why compute at render and not in the 409 handler: on the record page `RecordContext.refresh` is `handleManualRefresh`, a synchronous `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })` that returns `undefined`. `await ctx.refresh()` resolves before the re-read lands, and the handler's `record` closure is still the pre-409 row. A recompute inside the handler would read the stale row.

## Tests

New top-level `describe('#36036 …')` in the component's existing harness file `RecordStageMenu-35891.test.tsx`, which already holds the `#35956` block. Its host models the page's refresh: the notice returns at once and the re-read row lands on a later tick.

1. 409 where the other writer filled `loss_reason` → the field leaves, the description becomes the confirmation, no textbox. Move sends `{ stage: 'closed_lost' }` with the new `ifMatch` and no `loss_reason`.
2. CONTROL: a 409 that filled nothing (only the name changed) keeps `loss_reason` and the typed `Price`, and sends both with the new version.
3. Chained: typed `other` brought in `loss_detail`; the other writer stored a different reason → both leave, Move sends the stage alone.

## Acceptance notes

- Test placement: the claim's file surface named "a new card-named test". The pin went into the existing `RecordStageMenu-35891.test.tsx` as a top-level `describe` instead, per AGENTS.md ("A new pin for a component that already has a shared harness file goes into that file as a top-level `describe`, not a new file"). That file is where the `#35956` pin for this same dialog already lives.
- Observation, not filed (read inference only): in an `embedded` record view (list drawer, split preview), `RecordDetailView` passes `refresh={undefined}` to the header's `RecordContextProvider`. There the 409 branch's `ctx?.refresh?.()` re-reads nothing, so a second Move would carry the same stale `ifMatch`. Not reproduced. Whether the stage menu renders in embedded mode was not measured.

## Verification

- Read first: (1) `recordPathStageChange.tsx` `renderFieldsDialog`, the `asked` / `noLongerAsked` / `sendable` lines (the risk hunk: what the dialog shows and sends). (2) The `#36036` describe's `mountReRead` host, which must model the page's refresh honestly (the row lands after the notice returns).
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail exec vitest run --root ../.. --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordStageMenu-35891.test.tsx -t 36036`. Expect 3 passed.
